note: a street tile by what is around it: open NESW, inside corners NE SE SW NW, centre line e/n/x; reach: how far in from each edge an old block tile's asphalt starts (a share of the tile, null: none on the middle of that edge)
reach_cells: five rows of five, west to east then north to south, as the block picture lies (unmirrored); each [N, E, S, W] reach (-1 none), then [N, E, S, W] the asphalt span on that edge ([from, to] shares of the edge, west to east or north to south; -1 none)
